name: popover
useFor: Use for explanations, filters or small controls. Use variant="glass" over imagery or the header. Keep longer tasks in Dialog or Sheet.
constraints: Forms longer than a few fields (use a dialog)
Popovers that open on hover (use a tooltip)
documentation: Long content scrolls inside the panel (which keeps its drop) and fades at an edge with more past it (fade-y), with room for focus rings.
title: Popover
description: Anchored panel for contextual details or controls.
